# Avomeal

Avomeal is the public food/store brand created by VNV Events for South Florida customers. It is not Ophyra SaaS and should be described publicly as Avomeal.

Avomeal offers chef-prepared meal preps, holiday menus, party boxes, appetizers, sweets, dinner kits, individual food products and subscription-friendly meal ordering. Public Store and CMS data should remain scoped to the confirmed VNV Events owner `2`.

## Main Food Services

- Meal preps and weekly prepared meals
- Holiday menus and seasonal food packages
- Party boxes and celebration food kits
- Appetizers and finger foods
- Sweets, desserts and dessert trays
- Dinner kits and family meal support
- Individual prepared food products
- Subscription-friendly recurring meal orders
- Event food support connected to VNV Events
- Configurable minimum order applies at checkout

## Public Context Rules

- Use Avomeal as the public brand.
- Mention VNV Events as the creator/parent business where context is useful.
- Do not expose private panel, order, customer, team, payment or administrative data.
- Do not include drafts, noindex pages or private routes.
- Keep Store, checkout, subscriptions, cart recovery and customer flows customer-facing and scoped to owner `2`.
